releaseNotes: Four Completely Different Dashboard GUIs: 1) RACING (futuristic superbike cockpit, apex tachometer arc & shift lights, large center speed), 2) FACTORY (clean OEM motorcycle instrument cluster with traditional speedometer dial and telltales), 3) NIGHT (anti-glare dark HUD with dim red/amber instrument lighting and simplified vitals), 4) CUSTOM (user-personalized speedometer style, accent colors, modular grid/wing/stacked layouts, widget toggles). Includes prominent on-dashboard MODE selector with interactive preview cards.
